items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I heard the records -- Sweatman, I believe I heard him on clarinet. He was a great clarinetist I heard playing.

ctx.x: Had you heard jazz by this time?

Yes, I heard -- let's see, who did I hear? I heard the records -- Sweatman, I believe I heard him on clarinet. He was a great clarinetist I heard playing. At that time they called it ragtime. It was ragtime music. And then it went from ragtime to jazz, but some of them called it hoke. They called it hokum. Did you ever hear that name kicked around?
